checks.name: Type scale defines clear hierarchy
checks.notes: 34/28/22/17/15/13/10 pt scale well-defined in typography.ts with SF Pro Display for headings, SF Pro Text for body

checks.name: CTAs are visually prominent
checks.notes: Primary CTA uses #059669 green with elevation shadow, 12px border radius, 17pt semibold text

checks.name: Content grouping follows proximity law
checks.notes: 8pt grid system with xs(4)/sm(8)/md(12)/base(16)/lg(24)/xl(32) spacing scale; cards use 16pt padding

checks.name: Reading flow is natural (F-pattern/Z-pattern)
checks.notes: Main habits list follows natural top-to-bottom scan; header → progress → habit cards → FAB

checks.name: Color hierarchy supports visual weight
checks.notes: Primary green (#047857 text, #059669 buttons), gray-800 for headings, gray-500 for secondary, gray-400 for tertiary

checks.name: Whitespace is consistent between sections
checks.notes: Onboarding screen uses hardcoded spacing (gap:24, paddingBottom:60) instead of theme spacing tokens. Some components use raw values.

checks.name: Heading levels are semantically ordered
checks.notes: heading1(28pt) → heading2(22pt) → heading3(17pt) well-defined but some screens skip heading2 going directly from screen title to card titles

spacing.name: Scale is consistent
spacing.notes: 4pt increments throughout; componentSpacing provides card/button/input/listItem/modal presets

spacing.name: Consistent application
spacing.notes: OnboardingScreen uses raw values (gap:12, paddingHorizontal:16,32) instead of importing spacing tokens

spacing.name: Proximity law observed
spacing.notes: Cards grouped with 8pt vertical margin, internal padding 16pt; related elements use 4-8pt gap

colors.name: Contrast ratios WCAG AA
colors.notes: Gray-400 (#6B7280) on #faf9f7 background is ~4.1:1 — barely AA for normal text. stone-500 (#78716c) on warm background is ~3.9:1 — fails AA for body text.

colors.name: Strength level colors distinct
colors.value: 5 strength stages: lime→green→teal→cyan→emerald with matching light variants

elevation.name: Consistent shadow color
elevation.value: #1c1917 (warm stone-900) used across all elevation levels

elevation.name: Proper z-index layering
elevation.notes: Modals use elevation:6, FAB uses elevation:6, cards use elevation:3, subtle elements elevation:1

typography.name: Font hierarchy clear
typography.notes: SF Pro Display for display/h1, SF Pro Text for body/UI, SF Mono for data, Georgia for letters

typography.name: Letter spacing tuned
typography.notes: Negative tracking for body (-0.41) and small text (-0.24/-0.08); positive for headings (0.35-0.37)

typography.name: Max line length controlled
typography.notes: No explicit maxWidth constraint for body text. Screens use paddingHorizontal for implicit constraint but no typographic measure (45-75 chars) is enforced.

motion.name: Purpose-driven animations
motion.notes: Entrance animations for card stagger, celebration confetti for milestones, spring physics for gestures

motion.name: Duration range appropriate
motion.value: instant(100ms) → quick(150ms) → standard(200ms) → moderate(300ms) → emphasis(400ms) → complex(600ms)

motion.name: Easing/spring configs defined
motion.notes: 10 spring presets (bouncy, button, gentle, snappy, sheet, etc.) plus Motion.easing with cubic curves

motion.name: Reduce motion support
motion.notes: useReduceMotion hook reads system AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled; useReduceMotion.ts in components/Modal

motion.name: Stagger timing
motion.value: 60ms stagger in HabitCard entrance, 120ms in onboarding chain links

icons.name: Consistent icon library
icons.notes: Mix of emoji characters and icon components. Template grid uses raw emoji (🧘💧📖); other components use vector icons. No single icon library enforced.

icons.name: Icon sizes align with typography
icons.notes: micro(10) pairs with tabBar(10pt), small(16) with caption, medium(20) with bodySmall, large(24) with body/heading3

checks.name: Focus ring styles defined
checks.notes: focusRing.ts provides 2px border (#047857) with glow shadow, plus compact variant (1.5px)

checks.name: useFocusRing hook exists
checks.notes: useFocusRing in utils/accessibility with disabled support; integrated into HabitCard

checks.name: accessibilityRole on interactive elements
checks.notes: HabitCard uses role='button', onboarding buttons use role='button', proper labels throughout

checks.name: accessibilityLabel descriptive
checks.notes: HabitCard: '{name} habit, {strength}% strength, completed/not. Swipe left for actions.' — thorough

checks.name: accessibilityState used
checks.notes: HabitCard sets checked and disabled states correctly

checks.name: Touch targets meet 44pt minimum
checks.notes: componentSpacing.button.height=44, componentSpacing.input.height=44; skip button uses hitSlop=24 + minHeight:44

checks.name: Contrast ratios pass WCAG AA
checks.notes: Secondary text stone-500 (#78716c) on #faf9f7 ≈ 3.9:1 — fails AA (4.5:1 required for normal text). Gray-400 (#6B7280) marked 'WCAG AA compliant' in comments but is marginal at 4.1:1.

checks.name: Screen reader navigation order logical
checks.notes: HabitCard accessible prop set, but swipe actions are hidden behind gesture — screen reader users need accessibilityActions alternative. accessibilityHint mentions swipe but no VoiceOver custom actions defined.

checks.name: Dynamic Type support
checks.notes: Typography file documents Dynamic Type intent and mentions scaledValue() helper, but no actual implementation found — fontSize values are static pt values

checks.name: Reduce motion fully respected
checks.notes: useReduceMotion hook exists but not consistently applied. OnboardingScreen always uses springify animations without checking reduce motion preference.

checks.name: Color not sole information carrier
checks.notes: Strength levels use text labels ('Starting','Building',etc.) alongside color bars; streak badges include text + icon

checks.name: Error states announced to screen reader
checks.notes: ErrorBoundary and error fallbacks exist but no accessibilityLiveRegion='polite' found for dynamic error announcements

checks.name: Clear wayfinding — user knows where they are
checks.notes: Screen headers (HabitsHeader, AnalyticsHeader, DetailHeader) provide clear titles; tab bar with labels

checks.name: Tab bar follows platform conventions
checks.notes: tabBar height 49pt (iOS standard); 10pt font weight 500; includes CharacterScreen and AnalyticsScreen

checks.name: Back navigation consistent
checks.notes: HeaderButton component for back/close; modals have dismiss indicators and swipe-to-dismiss gestures

checks.name: Information architecture logical
checks.notes: Feature-rich with many modal layers (HabitsModals has 8+ modal types). Risk of modal fatigue. MotivationSystem/Workshop has deep nesting (Activation/Rescue/Reward/Workshop sub-systems).

checks.name: Sort/filter discoverable
checks.notes: SortChip component with SortBottomSheet; QuickPickChips for common sort presets

checks.name: Deep linking to habit detail
checks.notes: HabitDetailScreen exists as standalone screen but navigation from card is via modal (HabitCalendarModal) — two paths to similar content may confuse users

checks.name: Primary action discoverable (complete habit)
checks.notes: Tap on HabitCard toggles completion; QuickCompleteButton as alternative; clear visual feedback with confetti + strength fill

checks.name: Feedback on actions
checks.notes: Haptic feedback via expo-haptics on tap/toggle; toast notifications (CompletionToast, RewardCelebrationToast); animated strength fill; confetti burst on completion

checks.name: Error handling graceful
checks.notes: ErrorBoundary with ErrorFallback, RetryButton, SuggestionsCard; OfflinePendingBanner with sync status; circuit breaker pattern for network failures

checks.name: Cognitive load manageable
checks.notes: MotivationSystem has 4 sub-systems (Activation, Rescue, Reward, Workshop) each with multiple screens. Workshop alone has: WOOP, CueTrigger, DualViz, Affirmations, VoiceNotes, Letters, VisionBoard, Identity sections. May overwhelm new users.

checks.name: Undo available for destructive actions
checks.notes: UndoToasts on HabitDetailScreen; UnsavedChangesAlert guard on edit screens

checks.name: Loading states clear
checks.notes: Comprehensive skeleton loaders: AnalyticsScreenSkeleton, HabitCardSkeleton, HabitDetailSkeleton, HabitsPageSkeleton, SettingsModalSkeleton

checks.name: Offline experience graceful
checks.notes: Full offline queue system with OfflineProvider, circuit breaker, conflict resolution, sync orchestrator, and OfflinePendingBanner UI

checks.name: Swipe gestures have visual affordance
checks.notes: HabitCard swipe-to-reveal actions exist but no visual hint (edge peek or swipe indicator) guides first-time users

checks.name: First-run experience exists
checks.notes: 3-screen OnboardingScreen carousel: Chain visualization → Strength meter → Template grid

checks.name: Skip option available
checks.notes: Skip button top-right with hitSlop=24, minHeight:44; persists via AsyncStorage

checks.name: Progressive disclosure of features
checks.notes: Onboarding covers chain/strength/templates but doesn't introduce MotivationSystem features (WOOP, Rescue Mode, etc.). Heavy feature set discovered all at once post-onboarding.

checks.name: Empty state guides action
checks.notes: HabitsEmptyStateMinimal with HabitInput, SuggestionChips, CtaButton, InlineHint; templates accessible from empty state

checks.name: Visual illustrations engaging
checks.notes: Animated chain links, strength meter bars, template emoji grid with staggered spring entrance animations

checks.name: Onboarding respects reduce motion
checks.notes: OnboardingScreen uses FadeInDown.springify().damping(18) without checking useReduceMotion. No fallback for users with motion sensitivity.

checks.name: Create habit flow intuitive
checks.notes: HabitsEmptyStateMinimal provides inline HabitInput with chip suggestions; CreateHabitModalSection for full form

checks.name: Edit screen comprehensive
checks.notes: HabitEditScreen with NameInputSection, CustomizeSection (emoji/color), DangerZone (archive/delete)

checks.name: Unsaved changes protected
checks.notes: useUnsavedChangesGuard hook with back handler and confirm dialog

checks.name: Input validation present
checks.notes: utils/validation/ with email, password, text, security validators; useFieldValidation hook

checks.name: Settings organized logically
checks.notes: SettingsModal with AccountSection, StreakRemindersSection, LegalLinks, AppActions sections

checks.name: Form inputs meet minimum size
checks.notes: componentSpacing.input.height=44pt matches Apple HIG

checks.name: Error messages near inputs
checks.notes: Auth forms have AuthError component but ErrorMessage in HabitsEmptyStateMinimal uses animated toast-style positioning that may not be proximate to the triggering input

checks.name: Template preview before import
checks.notes: FullsizeTemplatePreview and TemplatePreviewModal provide detailed preview with name customization before import

checks.name: EmojiPicker accessible
checks.notes: EmojiPickerV2 with EmojiPickerSheet exists but no evidence of accessibilityLabel on individual emoji buttons in the grid

velocity.notes: Quick habit completion via tap gesture, FAB for fast creation, QuickCompleteButton, chip-based suggestions in empty state reduce time-to-first-habit. Optimistic mutations provide instant UI feedback.

efficiency.notes: Comprehensive skeleton loaders prevent layout shift. Offline queue with sync orchestrator ensures no lost data. Sort/filter system reduces scrolling for power users.

accuracy.notes: Contrast ratio issues may cause misreadings for low-vision users. Secondary text (#78716c) fails WCAG AA. Strength level colors are close in hue (lime/green/teal/cyan/emerald) — may be difficult for colorblind users to distinguish without labels.

innovation.notes: Unique strength-based habit tracking model with scientific backing (Huberman phases). MotivationSystem with WOOP, dual visualization, rescue mode, and voice notes is differentiated. Share card generator for social proof.

jtbdAnalysis.job: When I want to start a new habit, I want a simple way to track it daily so I can build consistency.
jtbdAnalysis.currentExperience: Excellent — empty state with inline input + chip suggestions gets user to first habit in <10 seconds. Onboarding explains chain metaphor.
gaps: No guided tour of MotivationSystem features

jtbdAnalysis.job: When I have an active streak, I want to be reminded and motivated to not break it so I can maintain my progress.
jtbdAnalysis.currentExperience: Strong — StreakReminders, RescueMode with failure visualization, StreakMilestoneCelebration, StreakChainSection visual.
gaps: Swipe actions not discoverable without prior knowledge
At-risk visual indicator could be more prominent

jtbdAnalysis.job: When I want to understand my habit patterns, I want detailed analytics so I can optimize my routine.
jtbdAnalysis.currentExperience: Good — AnalyticsScreen with charts, InsightsSection, WeeklyInsightsCard, TrendLineChart, StrengthHistoryChart, PredictionInsights.
gaps: Analytics screen may be overwhelming with many chart types
Export functionality exists but discoverability unclear

jtbdAnalysis.job: When I use assistive technology, I want the app to work correctly so I can track habits independently.
jtbdAnalysis.currentExperience: Moderate — focus rings, accessible labels, and reduce motion hook exist, but contrast failures and incomplete VoiceOver actions limit the experience.
gaps: Secondary text contrast fails WCAG AA
No VoiceOver custom actions for swipe alternatives

priorityFixes.title: Fix secondary text contrast ratio
priorityFixes.description: Change stone-500 (#78716c) secondary text color to stone-600 (#57534e) which achieves ~5.2:1 on #faf9f7 background. Update colors.text.secondary and colors.gray[500].

priorityFixes.title: Add VoiceOver custom actions to HabitCard
priorityFixes.description: Add accessibilityActions for 'edit' and 'delete' as alternatives to swipe gesture. Screen reader users cannot access swipe-revealed actions.

priorityFixes.title: Respect reduce motion in OnboardingScreen
priorityFixes.description: Import useReduceMotion and conditionally disable spring/fade animations. Use instant opacity transitions when reduce motion is enabled.

priorityFixes.title: Implement Dynamic Type support
priorityFixes.framework: Apple HIG - Dynamic Type, WCAG 2.1 AA §1.4.4
priorityFixes.description: Typography system documents intent but uses static pt values. Integrate react-native's fontScale or a scaledValue() helper to make text sizes respond to system font size settings.

priorityFixes.title: Consolidate to theme spacing tokens
priorityFixes.description: OnboardingScreen and other components use raw numeric values. Replace with spacing token imports (spacing.lg, spacing.base) for maintainability.

priorityFixes.title: Add swipe hint affordance to HabitCard
priorityFixes.description: Add subtle edge peek or first-time tooltip indicating swipe-to-reveal actions. Currently no visual affordance for new users.

priorityFixes.title: Progressive feature disclosure for MotivationSystem
priorityFixes.description: Workshop has 8+ sections visible simultaneously. Implement progressive unlock or contextual introduction to reduce cognitive overload for new users.

priorityFixes.title: Enforce max line length for body text
priorityFixes.description: Add maxWidth constraint (~600px / ~75 characters) for body text containers to maintain readable measure on larger screens.

priorityFixes.title: Standardize icon library
priorityFixes.description: Mix of emoji and vector icons. Define policy: emoji for user-chosen habit icons, single vector icon library (e.g., Lucide or SF Symbols) for all UI chrome icons.

priorityFixes.title: Add accessibilityLiveRegion for dynamic errors
priorityFixes.description: Error states and sync status changes should use accessibilityLiveRegion='polite' to announce changes to screen reader users without focus shift.
